skill.name: claudeemailmarketing
skill.description: Use when Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cowork, or another AI agent needs to plan, review, implement, audit, or improve email work focused on Claude-assisted positioning, segmentation, lifecycle content, and marketing review systems. Triggers include requests about offer refinement, segment-specific messaging, lifecycle copy reviews, positioning tests, and campaign strategy.
skill.summary: Plan, review, and QA Claude-assisted email marketing workflows with clear approval gates.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: No static findings were reported for this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, executable code, network access, credential handling, or unsafe live-email automation instructions.

content.value_statement: Email teams need segment-specific messages that stay within approved claims and review gates. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structure campaigns, prompts, critiques, tests, and handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Creates positioning briefs that connect segment, belief change, proof, and CTA.
Builds segment message matrices for offers, objections, and campaign angles.
Drafts Claude prompt packs bounded by approved evidence and brand constraints.
Reviews lifecycle copy for proof density, urgency, funnel fit, and measurement.
Plans email experiments with one meaningful variable and a success metric.
Prepares handoff notes with required owners and approval gates.
limitations: Does not send email, import contacts, edit DNS, or change production automations.
Requires source material for product claims, proof, audience context, and brand voice.
Cannot verify live email platform data unless the user provides current evidence.
Produces recommendations that still need human approval for risky changes.

use_cases.title: Refine an Offer Email
use_cases.description: Turn product facts, proof, and objections into a focused email angle and CTA.

use_cases.title: Audit Lifecycle Copy
use_cases.description: Review nurture, activation, retention, or winback emails for claim quality and funnel fit.

use_cases.title: Plan Campaign Tests
use_cases.description: Compare variants by audience fit, differentiation, proof, urgency, risk, and measurement.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Positioning Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $claudeemailmarketing. Create a positioning brief for this offer, segment, approved proof, main objection, and desired CTA: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Review Lifecycle Email Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $claudeemailmarketing. Review this lifecycle email for segment fit, proof, urgency, objections, CTA strength, and risky claims: [copy].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Segment Message Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $claudeemailmarketing. Build a segment message matrix for these audience situations, offers, proof points, objections, and funnel stages: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Design an Approval-Gated Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $claudeemailmarketing. Design an email experiment plan with one variable, success metrics, review owners, approval gates, and launch risks: [details].

output_examples.input: Review a reactivation email for inactive trial users.
output_examples.output: A structured critique covering segment tension, message angle, proof gaps, CTA fit, risky claims, and owner review notes.

output_examples.input: Plan a launch sequence for a new Claude-assisted workflow feature.
output_examples.output: A campaign recommendation with target segments, email angles, approved proof, experiment design, and approval steps before any send.

output_examples.input: Create prompts for Claude to generate campaign variants.
output_examples.output: A prompt pack that keeps Claude inside approved evidence, brand voice, funnel stage, and measurable campaign goals.

best_practices: Provide approved proof, product facts, brand voice examples, and claims that need review.
Define each segment by situation, intent, belief, and current funnel stage.
Separate recommendations from live actions, especially sends, imports, DNS changes, and automations.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to invent social proof, customer quotes, scarcity, guarantees, or product claims.
Treating Claude as an autopilot for live sends or production automation changes.
Testing many variables at once without a clear audience, metric, or review owner.

faq.question: Can this skill send marketing emails?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning, drafting, critique, and handoff. Live sends require separate human approval and tooling.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide offer details, target segment, funnel stage, approved proof, brand voice, objections, and the desired CTA.

faq.question: Does it help with lifecycle emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review activation, education, conversion, retention, recovery, announcement, and research workflows.

faq.question: Can it create testing plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose controlled email experiments with one meaningful variable and clear success metrics.

faq.question: How does it reduce marketing risk?
faq.answer: It asks for evidence boundaries, separates analysis from execution, and flags high-risk email system changes.
